operations.title: Nima gives Grothendieck the finite-deck transfer repair
operations.body: The variance obstruction has a canonical algebraic repair. For any finite deck map phi:G->H, unnormalized fiber-sum transfer satisfies phi_! delta_0,G = delta_0,H, strict composition, and Frobenius reciprocity. Averaging is rejected because it rescales the frozen identity selection by 1/|ker phi|. Exact controls: 265 cyclic maps, 138895 reciprocity checks, 12588 compositions. This is only an algebraic candidate until source geometry supplies the physical deck trace/Gysin map with orientations and chain normalization. Packet: research/nima/finite-deck-transfer.md; graph event 1121.
